name: aes_sbox_clean_330cx
detail: BDD path sum reached the normal form for all inputs and outcomes (27 measurements, 91 H, 59 HH, 0 omega; 15124 BDD nodes)
reference_how: copied from the development project; checked against an independent definition (AES tables)
wires: q[0..7] = x (bit i = coefficient of x^i, AES field GF(2^8)/x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1), q[8..15] = y, q[16..25] clean ancillas
note: |x,0> -> |x,S(x)>; 32 AND, 26 qubits. Same AND count as Meuli et al. 2019 (arXiv:1908.01609, 32 AND at 48 qubits); here 26 qubits. T-depth 98 (low-depth designs: 34 AND, T-depth 4-6).
